name: air-worker
description: AirWorker 0.11.11-rc.4 source candidate: native Codex/Claude route enforcement and Hermes plugin compatibility, shared learning reviewer capacity 64; not installed.

interface.shortDescription: Run native Codex orchestration and independent Claude review through AirWorker.
interface.longDescription: AirWorker is the sole native executor, judge and learning runtime for Codex, Claude and Hermes adapters. Use native session, PLAN, orchestrate and semantic receipts; the separate signed llm-queue worker is an optional heavy-task capability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the installed AirWorker kernel and the woody skill, not a direct Codex model call. Declare this session and read PLAN. Restore the accepted coding workflow: script-first, then air-worker executor dispatch -product <root> -class complex for the first Codex coding task (Sol medium), and only after terminal readback use -class bulk (Luna low) for the next bounded coding task; -class standard is available independently. Require real file edits, tests and a terminal receipt for every coding task. Use the independent factual judge and native Anthropic reviewer (Sonnet/Opus). air-worker orchestrate -product <root> -subagents 2 is optional read-only analysis plus leader, not a substitute for coding executors. Never use Codex App Server, direct claude -p, PAYG or a custom router.
